MelW.name: Rebuttal
MelW.tooltip:
Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles from enemy champions, gaining @ShieldAmount@ Shields for @Duration@ seconds and @MoveSpeed*100@% decaying Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

Reflected projectiles deal @DamagePercent@ original damage as magic damage.
Reflected projectile damage is calculated using the original caster's attributes before damage adjustments and magic penetration.
Physical damage is reduced by @PhysDamageMod*100@% when converted to magic damage.
Does not apply item effects from the original caster.
Projectiles targeting each enemy in an area are destroyed instead of reflected.

MelPassive.name: Searing Brilliance
MelPassive.tooltip:
Mel's Attacks and Abilities apply and refresh stacks of Overwhelm for @OverwhelmDuration@ seconds each time they deal damage, storing @spell.MelR:PassiveFlatDamage@ plus @spell.MelR:PassiveStackDamage@ damage per stack of magic damage. When applied, if the stored amount exceeds the enemy's combined shields and Health, they are executed.

When an Ability is cast, Mel's next Attack fires @PassiveBonusMissiles@ extra projectiles, each dealing @PassiveBonusMissileDamage@ magic damage. This effect can stack up to @MaxPassiveBonusMissiles@ extra projectiles.

MelR.name: Golden Eclipse
MelR.tooltip:
Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to @PassiveFlatDamage@ magic damage plus @PassiveStackDamage@ magic damage per stack.

Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing @UltFlatDamage@ magic damage plus @UltStackDamage@ magic damage per Overwhelm stack.

Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.

MelQ.name: Radiant Volley
MelQ.tooltip:
Mel unleashes a barrage of @ExplosionCount@ projectiles that explode in the area around a target location.

The first explosion hit deals @InitialExplosionDamage@ magic damage and each subsequent explosion deals @TotalExplosionDamage@ magic damage, adding up to @AllDamageHit@ magic damage total.

MelE.name: Solar Snare
MelE.tooltip:
Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for @RootDuration@ seconds and dealing @Damage@ magic damage.

The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by @AreaSlowAmount*100@% and deals @AreaDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second.
The Slow and damage-over-time effects linger on enemies for a short duration after they've left the area created by the orb.
Deals @MinionModTooltip@ reduced damage when used against minions.
